t.What did Shuayb tell his people about me: Muxuu Shucayb u sheegay qowmkiisa ku saabsan qiyaasidda iyo miisaanka?

t.What did baby Isa say first?: Maxaa Ciise oo ilmo yar ah markii ugu horreysay yiri?
t.What did the people of Thamud carve out: Maxay reer Thamuud ka qoteen buuraha?
t.What do we say when leaving the bathroom: Maxaan nidhaahnaa markaan musqusha ka baxno?
t.What happened when Musa struck the sea w: Maxaa dhacay markii Muuse badda ku garaacay ushiisa?
t.What name did Allah give Zakariya's son?: Magacee buu Allaah u bixiyay wiilka Zakariye?
t.What sign did Allah give the people of T: Calaamaddee buu Allaah siiyay reer Thamuud?
t.What was the first word revealed of the: Waa maxay erayga ugu horreeyay ee Qur'aanka la soo dejiyay?
t.Whatever happens, we can always call on: Wax kasta oo dhaca, had iyo jeer Allaah ayaan u yeeran karnaa.
t.When Allah's command came, Allah saved H: Markii amarka Allaah yimid, Allaah wuxuu badbaadiyay Huud iyo kuwii la rumeeyay, naxariistiisa awgeed.
t.When Allah's command came, Allah saved S: Markii amarka Allaah yimid, Allaah wuxuu badbaadiyay Shucayb iyo kuwii la rumeeyay, naxariistiisa awgeed.
t.When Musa went to meet his Lord for fort: Markii Muuse u aaday inuu la kulmo Rabbigiis afartan habeen, wuxuu Haaruun ka codsaday inuu qowmkiisa ku dhex mataalo oo arrimaha hagaajiyo. Markii dadka qaarkood lumeen, Haaruun wuxuu ku yiri: Rabbigiin waa Naxariis badane, ee i raaca oo amarkayga adeeca.
t.When he arrived in Madinah, he ordered a: Markuu Madiina yimid, wuxuu amray in masjid la dhiso. Milkiilayaashii dhulka waxay yiraahdeen: qiimihiisa waxaan ka rabnaa Allaah oo keliya.
t.When he travelled from Makkah, he hid in: Markuu Makka ka safray, wuxuu ku dhuuntay god isaga iyo saaxiibkiis, wuxuuna ku yiri: Ha murugoon, Allaah waa nala jiraa.
t.When he was forty, the first revelation: Markuu afartan jir ahaa, waxyigii ugu horreeyay wuxuu u yimid Godka Xiraa. Malaggu wuxuu yiri: Iqra' (Akhri)!
t.When it rains, we ask Allah to make the: Markuu roob da'o, Allaah ayaan ka baryaynaa inuu roobka noo yeelo khayr.
t.When one of you sneezes, let him say: Al: Midkiin markuu hindhiso, ha yiraahdo: Alxamdulillaah (mahad oo dhan Allaah ayaa leh).
t.When someone helps us, we thank them wit: Markii qof na caawiyo, ducadan ayaan ugu mahadnaqnaa.
t.When the Prophet ﷺ came to Madinah, he o: Markii Nabiga ﷺ Madiina yimid, wuxuu amray in masjid la dhiso.
t.When the flood came, Nuh carried the bel: Markii daadku yimid, Nuux wuxuu markabka ku qaaday mu'miniinta iyo xayawaan lammaane ah, wuxuuna ku socday mawjado buuro la mid ah.
t.When they were afraid, what did Allah te: Markay baqeen, muxuu Allaah ku yiri?
t.When things are hard, be patient and cal: Markay arrimuhu adkaadaan, samir oo Allaah u yeer.
t.When we come home, we say Bismillah and: Markaan guriga nimaadno, waxaan nidhaahnaa Bismillaah oo qoyskeenna salaan siinnaa.
t.When we come out of the bathroom, we ask: Markaan musqusha ka baxno, Allaah ayaan ka baryaynaa inuu noo dambi dhaafo.
t.When we enter the masjid, we ask Allah f: Markaan masjidka galno, Allaah ayaan ka baryaynaa naxariistiisa.
t.When we feel angry, we say this and calm: Markaan cadho dareemno, tan ayaan nidhaahnaa oo degnaa.
t.When we go out, we trust Allah to look a: Markaan baxno, Allaah ayaan talo saaranaa inuu na daryeelo.
t.When we leave the masjid, we ask Allah f: Markaan masjidka ka baxno, Allaah ayaan ka baryaynaa fadligiisa.
t.When we make a mistake, we say sorry to: Markaan khalad samayno, Allaah ayaan ka cudurdaaranaynaa oo ka baryaynaa inuu noo dambi dhaafo.
t.When we ride in a car or travel, we say: Markaan baabuur raacno ama safarno, ducadan Qur'aanka ka timid ayaan nidhaahnaa.
t.When we wake up, we thank Allah for a ne: Markaan toosno, Allaah ayaan ugu mahadnaqnaa maalin cusub.
t.When you enter the mosque, say: O Allah,: Markaad masjidka gasho, dheh: Allahayow, ii fur albaabada naxariistaada. Markaad ka baxdo, dheh: Allahayow, waxaan kaa baryayaa fadligaaga.
t.When you sneeze, say Alhamdulillah. The: Markaad hindhiso, dheh Alxamdulillaah. Qofka ku maqla wuxuu yiraahdaa Yarxamukallaah, adiguna waxaad ku jawaabtaa: Yahdiikumullaahu wa yuslixu baalakum.
t.Where did the first revelation come to t: Halkee ayuu waxyigii ugu horreeyay ugu yimid Nabiga ﷺ?
t.Which bird brought news to Sulayman?: Shimbirtee ayaa war u keentay Suleymaan?
t.Which dua asks Allah for more knowledge?: Ducadee ayaa Allaah ka baryaysa cilmi dheeraad ah?
t.Which hill did the Prophet ﷺ climb to ca: Buurtee ayuu Nabiga ﷺ fuulay si uu ugu yeero dadka Qurayshta?
t.Which name of Allah means the Creator?: Magacee ka mid ah magacyada Allaah ayaa macnaheedu yahay Abuuraha?
t.Which name of Allah means the Provider?: Magacee ka mid ah magacyada Allaah ayaa macnaheedu yahay Arzuqaha?
t.Which names mean the First and the Last?: Magacyadee ayaa macnahoodu yahay Kan Ugu Horreeya iyo Kan Ugu Dambeeya?
t.Which of these is NOT one of the four sa: Kuwan midkee AAN ka mid ahayn afarta bilood ee xurmada leh?
t.Which part do we wash last in wudu?: Qaybtee ayaan ugu dambeyn dhaqnaa weysada?
t.Which prophet struck the sea with his st: Nabigee ayaa badda ku garaacay ushiisa?
t.Which small creature warned the others i: Makhluuqee yar ayaa sheekadan ugu digay kuwa kale?
t.Which surah ends with many names of Alla: Suuraddee ayaa ku dhammaata magacyo badan oo Allaah ah: Al-Malik, Al-Qudduus, As-Salaam...?
t.Which two names come together at the sta: Labadee magac ayaa isla yimaada bilowga Aayatul Kursi?
t.Which way do we face when we pray?: Xaggee ayaan u jeesannaa markaan tukanayno?
t.While he was standing in prayer, the goo: Isagoo salaad u taagan, bishaarada ayaa timid: Allaah wuxuu siin doonaa wiil la yiraahdo Yaxye, magac aan Allaah hore cidna u bixin.
t.Who comforted the Prophet ﷺ after the fi: Yaa dejiyay Nabiga ﷺ waxyigii ugu horreeyay kadib?
t.Who is the last of the prophets?: Waa kuma kan ugu dambeeya nebiyada?
t.Who is truly strong?: Waa kuma kan runtii xoogga leh?
t.Who raised the foundations of the Kaaba?: Yaa kor u qaaday aasaaska Kacbada?
t.Who saw eleven stars, the sun and the mo: Yaa riyo ku arkay kow iyo toban xiddig, qorraxda iyo dayaxa?
t.Who should say salam first?: Yaa ay tahay inuu marka hore salaamo?
t.Whoever believes in Allah and the Last D: Qofkii rumaysan Allaah iyo Maalinta Aakhiro ha yiraahdo wax wanaagsan ama ha aamuso.
t.Whom did Musa ask Allah to make his help: Yuu Muuse Allaah ka baryay inuu caawiye uga dhigo?

t.Young Yusuf saw a dream: eleven stars, t: Yuusuf oo yar ayaa riyooday: kow iyo toban xiddig, qorraxda iyo dayaxa oo u sujuudaya. Wuxuu u sheegay aabbihiis Yacquub.
t.Your friend sneezes and says Alhamdulill: Saaxiibkaa ayaa hindhisay oo yiri Alxamdulillaah. Maxaad dhihi?
t.Yunus left his people and boarded a ship: Yuunus wuxuu ka tegay qowmkiisa oo fuulay markab buuxa.
t.Yunus was brought out onto the shore, an: Yuunus waxaa la soo saaray xeebta, Allaahna wuxuu dushiisa ka soo bixiyay geed.
t.Zakariya had grown old and his wife had: Zakariye wuu gaboobay xaaskiisuna carruur ma lahayn. Wuxuu Rabbigiis ugu yeeray si qarsoodi ah: Rabbiyow, xaggaaga iga sii ilmo wanaagsan. Adigu waad maqashaa duco kasta.
t.Zakariya took care of Maryam. Whenever h: Zakariye wuxuu daryeeli jiray Maryan. Mar kasta oo uu galo qolkeeda cibaadada, wuxuu la heli jiray cunto. Wuxuu weydiiyay: Xaggee tan ka timid? Waxay tiri: Waa xagga Allaah. Allaah wuxuu arzuqaa cidduu doono xisaab la'aan.
t.Zakariya wondered how this could be, and: Zakariye wuxuu la yaabay sida ay tani u dhici karto, Allaahna wuxuu yiri: Waa ii fudud tahay. Calaamad ahaan, Zakariye dadka lama hadlin saddex habeen calaamado mooyee, wuxuuna ku yiri Allaah tasbiixsada subax iyo fiid.
